description: System information, app launch, and app terminate. CPU, memory, disk, processes, uptime, open/close programs.

tools.name: sys_cpu
tools.description: CPU usage percent, frequency (MHz), core count, and temperature.

tools.name: sys_memory
tools.description: RAM total, used, available (GB) and percent used.

tools.name: sys_disk
tools.description: Disk total, used, free (GB) and percent for a given path (default: home).

tools.name: sys_processes
tools.description: Top N processes by CPU usage: pid, name, cpu_percent, memory_mb, status.

tools.name: sys_uptime
tools.description: System uptime in seconds and boot time as ISO-8601 UTC string.

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch a program by name (must be in PATH). Detaches from terminal.

tools.name: terminate
tools.description: Terminate a running program by name or PID. SIGTERM then SIGKILL. Only kills user-owned processes.
